preserve: Existing Windows Desktop installation path and HTTPS/API/WebSocket route
Hermes native owner, current containers, profiles and session data

hostSshPolicy.lifecycle: Reload ssh.service only after syntax and effective policy pass; never restart or change ssh.socket here.
hostSshPolicy.failure: An unvalidated newly created include is removed without reloading. After reload is attempted, preserve validated source and inspect native state before any retry.

firewallPolicy.jump: First INPUT rule: incoming eth0, UDP destination 8472 -> owned chain
firewallPolicy.persistence: Native systemd oneshot reasserts only this rule and chain after network-online.target and the native Tailscale/Docker startup ordering.
firewallPolicy.unitStop: Does not withdraw packet filtering; explicit helper remove is required for reversal.
firewallPolicy.unexpectedOwnership: Refuse unexpected owned-chain contents or references; never flush or replace foreign rules.
firewallPolicy.partialFailure: IPv4 and IPv6 commands are separate native effects. A nonzero result may leave one family applied; inspect both before retry or reversal.

verificationLimits: Local syntax and source review do not establish host application.
Firewall rule checks establish the configured narrow INPUT block, not Hostinger control-plane firewall state or external packet arrival.
No automatic native Work resume is part of the network policy.
